en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Misma’a, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
The one who dies in the throng (crowd) of the people on the day of Friday, or day of Arafaat, or upon a bridge, not being know who killed him, so his wergild is upon the public treasury’.
